title: Lean-certified Fourier transform on Sobolev spaces
question: Formalize Fourier-Plancherel correspondence for H2 functions on the plane with the exact normalization needed by fourth-order PDEs.
first_test: Prove the isometric isomorphism and derivative multiplier lemmas in Lean.

title: Verified nonlinear energy differentiability
question: Formalize Fréchet differentiability of a cubic–quintic Hamiltonian on a declared Sobolev function space.
first_test: Kernel-check the derivative formula and continuity assumptions.

title: Certified constrained minimizer existence
question: Formalize a conditional direct-method existence theorem for fixed-mass fourth-order energy minimizers.
first_test: Prove weak lower semicontinuity and compactness hypotheses without hidden axioms.

title: Lean orbital-distance quotient topology
question: Construct a metric or pseudometric for phase-translation orbit distance in H2 and prove its basic invariance properties.
first_test: Verify symmetry, triangle inequality and continuity of the group action.

title: Formal semigroup smoothing estimates
question: Kernel-check fourth-order parabolic semigroup bounds between fractional Sobolev spaces.
first_test: Prove operator-norm decay with explicit exponents.

title: Verified Fourier-mode projectors
question: Define finite spectral projectors on a torus in Lean and prove orthogonality and convergence for square-summable coefficients.
first_test: Prove Parseval-compatible strong convergence and frequency cutoff identities.

title: Lean proof of spectral gap persistence
question: Formalize perturbation bounds for a bounded self-adjoint operator with a fixed isolated spectral interval.
first_test: Prove persistence and a quantitative distance-to-spectrum estimate.

title: Certified local implicit-function branches
question: Formalize a parameter-dependent Banach-space implicit-function theorem and apply it to a frozen stationary wave equation.
first_test: Kernel-check differentiability, inverse conditions and local branch uniqueness.

title: Verified mass and energy conservation laws
question: Formalize the integration-by-parts identities used to prove conservation for sufficiently smooth fourth-order Schrödinger solutions.
first_test: Prove exact identities and then state the density extension assumptions.

title: Formal concentration radius inequalities
question: Construct a Lean proof of quantitative concentration inequalities controlling mass outside a ball for suitable Sobolev functions.
first_test: Kernel-check a radius estimate with all measure-theoretic hypotheses.

title: Lean Hamiltonian constraint matrix rank
question: Formalize Dirac constraint rank and nullity calculations for a finite polynomial auxiliary-field model.
first_test: Prove matrix ranks from symbolic coefficient hypotheses, avoiding numerical certificates alone.

title: Verified parameter identifiability ranks
question: Formalize rank and nullspace statements for the clipped spectral map's frozen derivative matrix.
first_test: Prove the conditional rank theorem and certificate validity.

title: Proof-assistant validated scattering normalization
question: Formalize unitarity of an abstract scattering operator under precisely stated wave-operator completeness assumptions.
first_test: Kernel-check the chain of functional-analytic implications.

title: Formal topological winding invariance
question: Formalize invariance of the integer degree of a nonvanishing continuous torus map under homotopy.
first_test: Prove the winding lemma without conflating it with PDE nonvanishing.

title: Certified error propagation for Galerkin ODEs
question: Implement an interval or rational certificate checker whose acceptance implies an explicit trajectory-error bound.
first_test: Prove the checker sound in Lean for a fixed polynomial ODE.

title: Lean-displayed counterexample provenance
question: Develop a machine-checkable format linking an explicit counterexample witness to the exact false theorem schema it refutes.
first_test: Prove sound extraction of the witness and test it on a concrete false claim.

title: Validated spectral eigenvalue enclosures
question: Construct rational interval certificates for isolated eigenvalues of a finite Fourier-Galerkin matrix.
first_test: Prove inclusion and separation using verified matrix inequalities.

title: Formal long-time Lyapunov descent
question: Formalize a strict Lyapunov function argument that guarantees convergence to an invariant set under compactness assumptions.
first_test: Kernel-check invariance and an exact proof of asymptotic approach.

title: Machine-checked model-to-model error theorem
question: Prove a generic numerical perturbation theorem transferring bounded residuals and stability constants to trajectory-error estimates.
first_test: Instantiate the theorem on a finite-dimensional fourth-order wave discretization.
